what: Stacked vertical photos, once the top of the section touches the top of the screen, scatter to their own set positions in 1s and appear at .5s, while the bottom photo is pushed up as the bottom margin grows. Leaving the section or scrolling back stacks them again along the same path

options.scope: Section to measure against — nearest ancestor selector (like .copy). If none, this element
options.end: Where it overlaps again (when passing downward), default bottom top
options.stay: if true, stays scattered even after scrolling past downward
options.--fx-x · --fx-y: Spot where each photo scatters (via style)
options.--fx-lift: How far the bottom photo is pushed up (bottom photo via style)
